translations.web: “Woe to the world because of occasions of stumbling! For it must be that the occasions come, but woe to that person through whom the occasion comes!
translations.bsb: Woe to the world for the causes of sin. These stumbling blocks must come, but woe to the man through whom they come!
translations.kjv: Woe unto the world because of offences! for it must needs be that offences come; but woe to that man by whom the offence cometh!
translations.asv: Woe unto the world because of occasions of stumbling! for it must needs be that the occasions come; but woe to that man through whom the occasion cometh!
